entries.user: Can we use this rotary screw compressor for food-grade water bottling? Need to know which IS standard applies and if it needs to be oil-free.

assistant.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
assistant.applicability: IS 14543 mandates that compressed air contacting packaging or product must be from oil-free or food-grade compressors. Rotary screw compressors with carbon-ring seals and class 0 air quality (per ISO 8573-1:2010) are compliant. Standard lubricated rotary screw is NOT compliant for direct food contact.
assistant.recommendation: Verify compressor data sheet specifies ISO 8573-1 Class 0 oil-free output. If not, install IS 14543 Annex C filtration train (coalescing + carbon + sterile).
compliance_checklist: Compressor data sheet declares ISO 8573-1:2010 Class 0 output?
If lubricated: H1 food-grade lubricant only (NSF registered)?
Annex C filtration train installed (coalescing → activated carbon → 0.01 µm sterile)?
Third-party IS 14543 audit on file (<12 months)?
FSSAI license valid for the bottling line?
assistant.verdict: conditional — compliant only if Class 0 oil-free OR H1 lubricant + Annex C filtration verified

assistant.priority_rationale: BIS QC blocked + operator-flagged urgent — escalates to P1 per shift-level SOP

assistant.corrective_action: 1. Verify sensor power & signal cable continuity. 2. Replace sensor module (consult drawing 4750-PM-CONV-02). 3. Recalibrate via IK11 measurement document. 4. Document in MN03 maintenance log. 5. Re-run BIS QC sample batch before line release.

workflow_sequence.action: Create M2 notification with Functional Location Line-2/Conveyor/Speed-Sensor-01
Convert to maintenance order, dispatch instrument tech
Confirm maintenance order completion with calibration certificate
Close notification with QC re-test pass result
